openings.claim: Date sheets and clearly mark one next preparation task.
openings.discriminator: Earlier-task errors decline; blanks may persist.
openings.probe: Count correct/earlier/blank answers against attendance; log printing and clarification minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Requires advance task selection and dependable paper access.

openings.claim: Keep the familiar routine; start pairs with a fresh self-contained reciprocal introduction and optional follow-up complexity.
openings.discriminator: Entry difficulty and early changes decrease; formation delays may persist independently.
openings.fit: Preserves H3-C1–C4; no public level labels.
openings.probe: Alternate ordinary/fresh prompts; observe delays/changes and anonymously ask attendance frequency, entry difficulty and useful speaking.
openings.uncertainty: Changing attendance confounds comparisons; existing sheets must supply prompts.

openings.claim: Give partners complementary scenario information, optional sentence starters, four six-minute exchanges, alternating leads and one optional partner change.
openings.discriminator: Reciprocal information needs improve entry and speech distribution beyond shared fresh prompts.
openings.probe: Compare shared/split-information rounds, reverse order, observe speech distribution and collect entry/usefulness reports.
openings.uncertainty: Allocated time is not useful speech; reading and sheet-production burden may dominate.

openings.claim: Replace changing homework with one enduring mission: bring a real question; offer existing prompts to unprepared arrivals.
openings.discriminator: Stable preparation reduces confusion and topic-selection effort while generating conversation.
openings.probe: Ask next action without sheets; check question usefulness, coordination activities and absent-participant paper access.
openings.uncertainty: Pickup permission, support workload and continued variety remain unverified.

lineage.reason: Adds information asymmetry and turn structure.

decision: Test separately over six sessions against original 80% speaking, 85% preparation and weekly coordination below 90 minutes, within 75-minute sessions. All remain hypotheses: 72 slips cover 97 attendances, speech was untimed and weeks unlinked; proficiency mismatch is unestablished.
